title: Smoky Syrian Pilaf with Cobnuts
description: A flavorful and nutritious pilaf dish featuring smoky flavors and crunchy cobnuts.
instructions: Heat kissed olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add Syrian rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add smoky paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in chopped cobnuts.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving platter and garnish with chopped parsley.
